entries.note: The production exact-read path calls this handle-identity guard at commands/file_read_exact.rs:75,144; subc/flow_read.rs:496 calls read_exact. This is a new live helper, not one of the historical four allowed-dead helpers.

The Windows source-replacement branch calls windows::link_count at edit.rs:339 to reject multiply linked files. Its declaration is in the cfg(windows) module; a Linux rustc lint count cannot establish Windows liveness.

The shared replacement path calls xattrs::copy_platform_security at edit.rs:384. Separate cfg(target_os) definitions implement macOS ACL copying and the Linux no-op; the reported source name has a real production caller.

The production copy_access path calls xattrs::platform_acls_match at edit.rs:396. Both Linux and macOS implementations are live on their platforms; collapsing cfg-alternative copy_access bodies lost this edge.

The macOS platform_acls_match implementation calls extended_acl_text twice at edit.rs:684, and clear_extended_acl uses it at :747,766. Production ACL comparison/removal reaches it, independently of its test callers.

The macOS source_recovery::make_private variant calls super::source_replacement::xattrs::clear_extended_acl at edit.rs:1014. Recovery save invokes make_private; its other platform definitions must not replace this source body in liveness analysis.

The Windows copy_access variant calls windows_dacl::copy_protected at edit.rs:410; source_recovery::make_private also calls it at :1028. These protect replacement and recovery DACLs in production, not only tests.

The production scope worker passes describe_answer_ends_scope as the is_ok_and callback inside tokio::select! at scope_describe.rs:187. Opaque macro tokens previously retained calls but omitted this function-item argument.

render_catalog calls broca_text for CatalogPreset::Head at tool_provider.rs:598-611. remote_policy.rs:195-207 selects then invokes the catalog renderer as a function value; losing that conditional value edge incorrectly orphaned the live rendering chain.

render_catalog calls worker_text for CatalogPreset::Worker at tool_provider.rs:598-611. The production remote-policy catalog route reaches render_catalog through its selected renderer; this is not a test-only function.

render_catalog calls reader_text for CatalogPreset::Reader at tool_provider.rs:598-611. The production remote-policy catalog route reaches render_catalog through its selected renderer; the named reader preset is accepted in production.

remote_policy.rs:195-199 selects tool_provider::catalog_for_confined_request in the confined branch and invokes the resulting render function at :200-207. A scoped function path returned from an if branch is a value reference, even though it is not called at that expression.
